ALLOWED_IDENTITY_ORIGINS.description: Trusted HTTPS Navidrome/Subsonic origins, comma-separated; do not include a port unless the origin actually uses a non-default HTTPS port.

ENABLE_OFFLINE_HANDOFF.description: Boolean: allow a device to take over playback from an offline device within the eight-hour snapshot window.

MAX_DEVICES.description: Number from 1 to 1000: maximum registered devices per account.

STABLE_KEY.description: Secret HMAC key, at least 32 random characters. Generate it in a password manager and keep it unchanged across deployments.
